note: Original Hard stats, loot and player kits stay pinned to the pre-difficulty game. Intentional biome and weapon-roster results are recorded separately. weaponLootHash moved a second time when the three thrown bases left the weapon slot for their own: the weapon drop pool has three fewer entries and a new slot has three, so every roll after the first shifts. enemyHp has not moved and must not: nothing in the weapon work touches monster health, so a change there is a bug, not a rebaseline. varietyFloorHash rebased for depth scaling (map 47→51 on D6, enemies +30-40%, 1 guaranteed secret + scaling 2nd): intentional generation change, loot/enemyHp untouched. Rebasing again for the throne fog gate (boss:true on the throne door): same reason, loot/enemyHp untouched. elementalFloorHash records the elemental biome pass (new residents, root caches, decorative icicles) on pre-expansion maps. expandedFloorHash is the merge of both (expanded bounds/rooms/enemies/secrets + elemental residents/props). Economy integration reduces shrine/gold generation and urn/chest gold, and adds blood/combat shrines. weaponLootHash uses the economy value; expandedFloorHash is recomputed for elemental content plus those generation changes. Historical hashes and monster/player health remain unchanged. preEconomyExpandedFloorHash preserves the prior elemental-plus-expanded-map result. Rat King pass: rat_king (54/12/4, D3-5, weight 1.2) joins the spawn pool, so expandedFloorHash moves; loot/enemyHp untouched. Rat Seraph pass: rat_king becomes rat_seraph (display, sprite and art retheme to a vermin ophanim; stats, depths and weight unchanged), so expandedFloorHash moves again; loot/enemyHp untouched. Bog Seraph placement: favored in Sunken Catacombs (D3 overlap only) and Sporegrove (D3-5 home); spawn weights shift, so expandedFloorHash moves; loot/enemyHp untouched. Grove lock: rat_seraph spawns only in Sporegrove (mole-style pool filter) at weight 2.3, ~15% of Grove spawns; expandedFloorHash moves; loot/enemyHp untouched. Final rename: rat_seraph becomes bog_seraph (display was already Bog Seraph; enemy id, sprite and art ids follow), so expandedFloorHash moves; loot/enemyHp untouched. Champion-tier buff: bog_seraph 54/12/4 weight 2.3 becomes 145/21/13 weight 0.6 with slower elite cadence and richer pay; spawn distribution shifts, so expandedFloorHash moves; loot/enemyHp untouched. Flash/Backstep scrolls: the vault/secret good-consumable pool grows from recall/identify to four scrolls, so scrollLootHash moves; enemyHp untouched and materialLootHash stays frozen as the pre-scroll record.
